rules.title: Variance of a parameter is the meet over its occurrences
rules.statement: The variance of a type/lifetime parameter `p` in a type `T` is `variance_in_type(T,p,ambient=Co)`, computed structurally: a leaf occurrence of `p` contributes the ambient variance; a parameter that does not occur is bivariant (BiVar). The overall variance combines occurrences via the meet operator (variance_meet); an unmentioned parameter stays BiVar (unconstrained).
rules.uncertainty: variance_meet/variance_compose lattice (BiVar top, Co/Contra, Inv bottom) defined elsewhere; semantics inferred from usage.

rules.title: Shared reference is covariant in lifetime and pointee
rules.statement: `&'a T` is covariant in its lifetime `'a` (contributes ambient) and covariant in its pointee `T` (recurses with unchanged ambient).

rules.title: Mutable reference is covariant in lifetime, invariant in pointee
rules.statement: `&'a mut T` is covariant in its lifetime `'a`, but invariant in its pointee `T` (recurses with ambient composed with Inv).

rules.title: Raw pointers: *const covariant, *mut invariant
rules.statement: `*const T` is covariant in pointee `T`; `*mut T` is invariant in pointee `T` (ambient composed with Co or Inv respectively). Matches Rust.

rules.title: Tuples, arrays, and slices are covariant in element types
rules.statement: A tuple is covariant in each element type (meet over elements, unchanged ambient); `[T; N]` and `[T]` are covariant in element type `T` (recurse with unchanged ambient).

rules.title: ADT variance is per-parameter from the computed variance table
rules.statement: For a struct/zoned-struct/enum `D<A0..,'L0..>`, the variance contribution of each type argument `Ai` (resp. lifetime arg) is the meet over arguments of `compose(ambient, declared_variance(D,#i))` recursed into `Ai`, where `declared_variance(D,#i)` (`@i` for lifetimes) comes from the variance table keyed by `pkg.Name`; a parameter absent from the table defaults to covariant (Co).

rules.title: UnsafeCell<T> is invariant in T
rules.statement: `logos.lang.cell::UnsafeCell<T>` (the interior-mutability lang item, recognised by qualified name) is invariant in each type argument (ambient composed with Inv), overriding the table-driven ADT rule.

rules.title: Function types are contravariant in parameters, covariant in return
rules.statement: A function item or function pointer `fn(P0..)->R` is contravariant in each parameter type `Pi` (ambient composed with Contra) and covariant in the return type `R`.

rules.title: Trait objects: covariant in lifetime bound, invariant in type args
rules.statement: `dyn Trait<A...> + 'a` is covariant in its lifetime bound `'a` (the erased object's storage must outlive `'a`) and invariant in each type argument `Ai` (ambient composed with Inv); auto-trait bounds (Send/Sync) are set-membership and contribute nothing to variance.

rules.title: Type kinds not contributing the parameter are bivariant
rules.statement: A type that does not mention the target parameter (or whose kind is not variance-relevant) contributes BiVar (the identity for meet, i.e. no constraint).

rules.title: ADT variances computed by monotone fixpoint over fields
rules.statement: Variances of all struct/datatype/enum parameters are computed by a fixpoint iteration: each parameter is seeded BiVar, then on each round its variance is set to the meet over all field types (enum: over all variant payload types) of `variance_in_type(field, param, ambient=Co)`; iteration repeats until no entry changes, bounded at 32 rounds.
rules.uncertainty: The 32-round cap is an implementation safety bound; the language semantics is the least fixpoint.
